content:
We need propose retrosynthesis route up to 3 steps, leaves must be commercially available, total price <=9999 (we cannot check price but assume buyable). Need to produce target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We have identified some buyable building blocks: Cc1ccc(S(=O)(=O)Cl)cc1 (p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride), Nc1ccc(N)cc1 (p-phenylenediamine?), actually that's aniline with amine at para? Wait Nc1ccc(N)cc1 is p-phenylenediamine (two amines). Also C=CC(=O)Cl (acryloyl chloride). All are buyable.

We can think of synthetic route:

Step 1: Couple p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride with p-aminophenyl (or aniline) to form sulfonamide: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)Cl)cc1 + Nc1ccc(N)cc1? Actually sulfonyl chloride reacts with aniline to give sulfonamide: Cc1ccc(S(=O)(=O)Cl)cc1 + Nc1ccc(N)cc1 -> Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)Nc1ccc(N)cc1)cc1 (p-tolyl sulfonamide with aniline). But target has sulfonamide attached to phenyl ring (the second phenyl) which also has a side chain /C=C/C(=O)N-... So we need a phenyl bearing a para-amine that will be acylated with acryloyl chloride then amidated with aniline? Actually target: ...c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2 attached to sulfonyl group. So the second phenyl (sulfonyl attached) has a para substituent: a trans-α,β-unsaturated amide linking to an aniline (para-aminophenyl). So we can construct that side chain via a Heck-type? Actually /C=C/C(=O)N-... is a cinnamoyl amide. Could be formed by coupling acryloyl chloride with aniline to give acryloyl anilide (C=CC(=O)Nc3ccccc3N). Then perform a Heck coupling (or Wittig) to attach to phenyl? But we need to attach the acryloyl anilide to the phenyl via a trans double bond (C=C). Could be via a Suzuki coupling of a vinyl halide? Simpler: Use a known reaction: Heck coupling of p-iodophenyl sulfonamide with acrylamide? Actually we could start from p-iodophenyl sulfonamide (the sulfonamide attached to phenyl with iodo para). Then Heck with acryloyl anilide (or with N-phenylacrylamide). But we have limited templates.

Maybe easier: Use a condensation of aldehyde with aniline to form imine then oxidation? Not.

We can search for template that forms C=C bond via Wittig? Let's search for templates that form C=C (C-C double bond) broken/formed.
